strings.name: Kohei Uchimura
strings.role: Artistic gymnast · Two-time Olympic all-around champion
strings.summary: Uchimura set a men's all-around benchmark through execution and consistency across six apparatus. He won the six World all-around championships held from 2009 to 2015 and Olympic all-around gold in 2012 and 2016. He also helped Japan regain world and Olympic team titles. Injuries later narrowed his focus to high bar; after retiring in 2022, he continued promoting gymnastics through commentary and public activity.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: An Olympic and world gymnastics all-around champion whose sustained consistency established a competitive benchmark for the sport.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Kitakyushu, Fukuoka, Japan; grew up in Nagasaki.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Sustained all-around dominance
strings.highlights.h1.text: Won six World and two Olympic all-around titles from 2009 to 2016.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and early training
strings.facts.f2.value: Started in his parents' gym and later attended Nippon Sport Science University.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Japan's team titles
strings.highlights.h2.text: Contributed to world team gold in 2015 and Olympic team gold in 2016.
strings.timeline.t1.title: World Championships commentary
strings.timeline.t1.text: Commented on Rotterdam as a retired gymnast and broadcaster, not a current competitor.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Announced retirement
strings.timeline.t2.text: Ended competitive gymnastics and later held a farewell exhibition.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Tokyo high-bar appearance
strings.timeline.t3.text: Focused on high bar but fell in qualification and missed the final.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Injury interrupted all-around run
strings.timeline.t4.text: An ankle injury in world qualification ended his long championship sequence.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Two Rio golds
strings.timeline.t5.text: Won individual all-around and men's team gold.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Sixth World all-around title
strings.timeline.t6.text: Won a sixth consecutive edition and helped Japan win team gold.
strings.timeline.t7.title: London all-around champion
strings.timeline.t7.text: Won his first individual Olympic all-around gold.
strings.timeline.t8.title: First World all-around title
strings.timeline.t8.text: Began his consecutive championship run in London.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Two Beijing silvers
strings.timeline.t9.text: Won individual all-around and men's team silver.
